title:
UPDATE: **Summary:**
Investigating access issues with Classroom’s new web homepage.
**Description:**
We are investigating reports of access issues with Classroom’s new web homepage beginning on Thursday, 2026-08-13.
Our engineering team is currently working on a potential fix while continuing to investigate the full root cause.
We will provide an update by Tuesday, 2026-08-18 13:00 PDT with current details.
We apologize to all who are affected by the disruption.
**Symptoms:**
Admins and some Teachers may experience permission errors when accessing Classroom’s new web homepage.
**Workaround:**
Users should still be able to navigate to other views from the left hand pane of the interface.
